description_append: PMID:10913096 additionally reports that pectinase-digested citrus or apple pectin increased the yiaJ/plaR-lacZ reporter 10-20-fold in ECL1, but not JA134. Structural-gene expression was unaffected even without the repressor, and the biological significance remained unresolved. Preparation: 0.14% pectin in sodium acetate, pH 4.0; overnight at 25 C with 400 U Aspergillus niger pectinase; tenfold dilution into medium. This undefined hydrolysate is retained as experimental context, without assigning an individual chemical or a PlaR-binding interaction.
